ideas.title: The Impact of the Child Care Funding Freeze on Families
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the Trump administration's decision to freeze child care funding for 5 Democratic-led states on families and child care providers.
ideas.angle: The human impact of the funding freeze
questions: How many families will be affected?
What are the potential long-term consequences?
ideas.insight: This story would provide a personal perspective on the funding freeze and its consequences, highlighting the need for a thorough investigation into the allegations of fraud.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the massive fraud scheme in Minnesota and the surge in prosecutors to bring fraudsters to justice.
ideas.angle: The investigation into the fraud scheme
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story would provide an in-depth look at the fraud scheme and the efforts to bring those responsible to justice, highlighting the importance of thorough investigations and accountability.
